g.text: U-NET++ SEGMENTATION & HYDRODYNAMIC PINN DEPTH ENGINE
Nested Dense Skip Connection Radar Extent Model Coupled with 2D Shallow Water Physics-Informed Neural Network
All-Weather SAR Inundation Segmentation · 25.8M Parameters · Dense Nested Skip Decoders
Calibrated Sentinel-1 SAR Backscatter [Band 1: VV (dB), Band 2: VH (dB)]
NESTED DENSE SKIP PATHWAYS & UPSAMPLING DECODER GRID
Reduces semantic gap between encoder features and decoder representations via intermediate conv nodes
Pixel-wise flood probability distribution P(inundated | VV, VH) in [0.0, 1.0]
Threshold: P >= 0.50 yields binary water mask | Feeds Directly into PINN Channel 1
2D Shallow Water Equations + Manning Surface Friction Constraint · 85K Parameters
Channel 1: U-Net++ Flood Probability | Channel 2: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM Topography (30m)
Channel 3: ECMWF ERA5 24h Cumulative Precipitation Inflow R(t)
1. Continuity Residual: || ∇ · (h · v) - R(t) ||^2 where S = |∇η| / Δz, v = (1/n) * h^(2/3) * S^(1/2)
L_total = 3.0 * L_consistency + 1.0 * L_smoothness + 0.5 * L_continuity + 2.0 * L_nonneg + 0.3 * L_weak_supervision
• Consistency: Enforces h = 0 in dry zones (P < 0.5) and h > 0 in inundated zones (P >= 0.5)
• Smoothness: First-order Total Variation penalty ||∇h|| on continuous water surface elevations
• Non-negativity: L_nonneg = ||min(h, 0)||^2 strictly preventing unphysical negative depth values
CALIBRATED WATER DEPTH HEAD (1x1 CONV + SOFTPLUS x SCALE)
Output: h(x,y) continuous water depth in meters [0.0 m to 8.5 m] across full terrain bathymetry
Feeds: 3D Bathymetry Terrain Mesh, Dynamic Cross-Section Profiler, & Risk Classifier
